eq-ch12-wb-reference-filter: The fourth-order cell density reference: the reference pressure times the five-point filtered $\rho/p$ ratio.
eq-ch12-centroid-pressure: Integration by parts splits the radial pressure acceleration into the face pressure flux and an $r$-weighted source.
eq-ch12-flux-covariance-energy: The lateral energy-flux correction: an enthalpy covariance term minus a face-centroid shift term.
eq-ch12-mass-covariance-mean: The plain velocity mean is the density-weighted mean minus $\Delta x_1^2\,\partial_1\rho\,\partial_1v_1/(12\rho)$.
eq-ch12-radial-exact-budget: The corrected potential energy and its change, both linear in density through the centroid slope.
